title: Ajab Gazabb Love
desc: Rich Rajveer falls for Madhuri, who despises wealthy men. To win her heart, he and his family pretend to be poor to gain her affection.

title: Citylights
desc: Hoping to escape hardship, a farmer and his family leave their village behind and move to the city, dreaming of a better future amidst new challenges.

title: Gangster
desc: Simran is the girlfriend of Daya, a gangster. She re-locates to Seoul and befriends Akash, a singer in a restaurant. Their friendship develops into love. She has to make a choice between Daya and Akash.

title: Sarkar 3
desc: Gandhi seeks Sarkar's assistance for a project that will displace people. Sarkar refuses, triggering intense conflicts as power, politics, and betrayal take center stage in this gripping story.

title: Kites
desc: A wounded man searches for his sweetheart in the Mexican desert while on the run from the police, bounty hunters, and others.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee, an Indian woman living in Norway, battles to regain custody of her children after Norwegian authorities remove them from her care, fighting against legal and cultural challenges.

title: Awarapan
desc: Shivam, a hitman, is asked to keep an eye on his boss's mistress. However, he soon learns that she has been a victim of sex trafficking and decides to unite her with her lover.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
desc: The journey of a brothel worker's rise to power, as she fights for women's rights and earns public respect, defying patriarchy with strength and dignity.

title: Chhatriwali
desc: Sanya, a chemistry whiz without a job, aims to educate young minds about sex, breaking taboos while seeking opportunities to share her expertise.

title: Daas Dev
desc: Dev, the son of a powerful politician, finds himself torn when his lover, Paro, challenges his beliefs and decisions on politics, forcing him to choose between love and legacy.

title: Beyond The Clouds
desc: The emotional story of siblings reunited by a drug bust, navigating hardship and hope in the slums of Mumbai as they struggle for survival, forgiveness, and dignity.

title: Yeh Zindagi Ka Safar
desc: A young woman's perfect world crumbles after she reads an article written by an ambitious editor. Determined to unearth the truth about her past, she sets out on a painful journey, with him in tow.
